name: spatial clustering benchmark (spatial transcriptomics)
description: Evaluates spatial clustering methods using spatially resolved transcriptomics data to assess clustering accuracy and spatial coherence.
evaluation_method: Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) (often reported alongside NMI and silhouette scores)
reputation: Moderately used within the spatial-transcriptomics/bioinformatics community as a standard way to benchmark spatial clustering methods, but there is no single universally adopted canonical dataset.
notes: Non‑LLM benchmark; results sensitive to batch effects, varying spatial resolution and sequencing depth, and choice of preprocessing; many public datasets are small or highly heterogeneous which can inflate method variance.
